plain: A gift or grant that is given.

webster.text: The act of giving gratuitously; a conferring.

more.text: That which is conferred, or given; donation.

example.quote: How easy will it be to gain over a sufficient number, in the bestowment of offices, to promote the views and the purposes of those who grant them!
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
